'''Plan G-Prime''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] defensive plan. It was used by the defenders of the ''[[Black Ice/Legends|Black Ice]]'' during its [[Battle for Black Ice|capture]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].
